summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered private placement of 839,725 common shares at $9.70 per share, raising about $8.15 million, issued October 1, 2026 under subscription agreements and exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S. The price equals the September 30, 2026 NAV per share. The board separately declared a $0.068 per-share distribution to holders of record October 21, payable about October 28, 2026. No strategic transaction or special situation; routine periodic share issuance and dividend by a non-traded BDC. Watch NAV stability and distribution coverage.
